description: Project-level Claude Code settings for edopro-retro-formats. The Stop hook captures each session's final reply into a shared .git/agent-inbox/ as a convenience layered on the canonical self-report (docs/agents/reports.md): it hands the text to tools/report.py's writer, so the role tag is still derived from the checkout (.worktrees/<role>). It only fires for Claude Code sessions; every seat on every tool must still write its own report, and a missing or stale inbox file means 'unknown', never 'nothing happened'. The push-readiness gate deliberately does NOT live here: it is a real Git pre-push hook (.githooks/pre-push -> scripts/check_push_readiness.py, tested by tests/test_push_readiness.py), because a Claude Code Bash hook both missed ordinary pushes and blocked non-pushes, and never fired at all for a round run on another tool. See docs/agents/push-gate.md. The Stop hook uses a shell shim that probes python3, then python, and skips with a clear message if neither is available; the inbox script remains non-blocking.
